title: The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice
abstract: arXiv:2608.28930v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hidden-state probes effectively detect LLM hallucinations, but the geometry of the signal remains poorly characterized, driving increasingly complex probe architectures. Across three 7B-scale models and three datasets in a paired-example paradigm, we find the signal overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, and removing this direction collapses detection to chance. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis closes about 73% of the gap between 1D and full-dimensional classifiers, so apparent architectural complexity largely reflects high-dimensional covariance estimation difficulty rather than exploitable non-linearity. A simple L2-regularized logistic regression (0.952 AUROC) bounds or outperforms twelve controlled architectural alternatives, and our multi-layer aggregation exceeds CLAP cross-layer attention probing under matched paradigm. translated_title: 幻觉信号是一种均值偏移：为什么简单的探针就足够了
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.28930v1 公告类型： cross 摘要： 隐藏状态探针能有效检测大语言模型（LLM）的幻觉，但该信号的几何特性仍未得到充分刻画，这推动了日益复杂的探针架构的出现。在三个7B规模模型和三个数据集的配对样本范式下，我们发现该信号绝大部分由单一的均值偏移成分主导，而移除这一方向会使检测性能降至随机水平。收缩线性判别分析可以弥合一维分类器与全维分类器之间约73%的性能差距，因此表面上需要的架构复杂性主要反映了高维协方差估计的困难，而非可利用的非线性。一个简单的L2正则化逻辑回归（0.952 AUROC）能够限定或超越十二种受控的架构替代方案，并且在相同范式下，我们的多层聚合方法超越了CLAP跨层注意力探针。由于该信号跨越一个连续的层带，LayerMix将其聚合以匹配或……（原文截断于此）
tldr: 该论文发现LLM幻觉检测信号绝大部分由单一的均值偏移成分主导，因此简单的L2正则化逻辑回归探针即可达到甚至超越复杂探针架构的检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that the LLM hallucination detection signal is overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, so a simple L2-regularized logistic regression probe matches or outperforms complex probe architectures.
